shortDescription: An inheritable Storageborn xenotype: nomadic, sapient living furniture with randomized body forms, age-based carrying capacity and armor, configurable refuge recruitment, and body-specific gene bundles.
body:
## Storageborn xenotype
- Adds inheritable xenotype `omw_storageborn`, the `OMW_Storageborn` membership gene, the `OMW_StorageHead` head gene, fourteen randomized body genes, and five age-stage genes.
- Requires Biotech, Harmony, and Big and Small - Genes and More (`redmattis.bigsmall.core`); loads after Harmony and Big and Small, and before `mlie.10xcarryingcapacity`.
- The membership gene suppresses visible tattoos and applies Storageborn setup and body selection. The xenotype is non-combatant and inheritable, with Big-and-Small diet, unliving, reproductive, clothing/equipment, resilience, pain, sensory, temperature/toxic, sleep, armor, movement, and skill-affinity genes. Vanilla thought nullifiers remove many inappropriate apparel, beauty, sleeping, food, social, title-room, and corpse penalties.
- The custom head gene renders `Head/StoragebornHead` through `PawnRenderNode_AttachmentHead`, uses bald/no-beard filters and Big-and-Small facial-disabling support, and ships the runtime-requested eye texture. Body genes disable facial animations and select directional artwork through Big-and-Small `PawnExtension.bodyPaths`.

## Body forms, gene bundles, and settings
- Defines six extensible body categories: Neolithic, Medieval, Industrial, Spacer, Ultra, and Archotech. Current body genes are Luggage, Mimic, Cardboard, Maid, Cube, Treant, Golem, Suitcase, Wardrobe, Orb, MechLoader, Cube2, Robot, and Robot2; each has a category extension and directional textures.
- The controller discovers categories and body genes from loaded defs, allowing compatible mods to add categorized body genes.
- `StoragebornBodyGenesExtension` is an optional `DefModExtension` with a `<genes>` list of `GeneDef` references. `OMW_StorageBodyBase` assigns the `StoragebornBodyGene` class, so body genes inheriting that base can declare additional genes without code changes. On `PostAdd`, each listed gene is resolved and added as an endogene; the created `Gene` instances are tracked on that body-gene instance. On `PostRemove`, those tracked instances are removed. Missing list entries log an error on each add/remove callback.
- `StoragebornBodyBackstoriesExtension` optionally accepts a `<backgrounds>` list of `BackstoryDef` references. When a body gene with a non-empty list is added, one valid background is randomly chosen and assigned as the pawn's childhood backstory; an absent or empty list preserves the default childhood assignment. All fourteen active body genes specify fitting backgrounds covering nature, mimics, medieval furniture, industrial furniture/storage, spacer robots, and ultra robots; bodies with multiple matches randomize among them.
- Hovering a body icon in the Bodies settings tab shows the labels of all genes listed in that body's `StoragebornBodyGenesExtension`; bodies with no listed genes show a localized empty-state tooltip.
- The settings window has Bodies, Storage carrying capacity stages, and Refuge quest tabs. The Bodies tab calculates its scroll-content height from the discovered body and category counts, accommodating additional body defs. Body settings support optional World Tech Level integration (`m00nl1ght.WorldTechLevel`), category and individual toggles, effective-status explanations, and rerolling all discovered Storageborn pawns. The effective body pool controls initial randomization, rerolls, and quest pawns.
- Settings checkbox rows have a 16-pixel left inset, stage offset/factor fields are 100 pixels wide with expanded labels arranged in separate rows and an additional 16-pixel inset, and a persistent reset button restores all settings and reapplies the default stage stats.
- The stage tab edits five offsets and factors and applies them to `CarryingCapacity` plus optional `VEF_MassCarryCapacity`; settings persist through `ModSettings`/Scribe.

## Body randomization and lifecycle
- Adding the membership gene removes discovered Storageborn body genes and adds one randomly selected effective body gene as an endogene. Rerolling scans maps, caravans, and alive/dead world pawns with deduplication.
- Applying Storageborn setup assigns `OMW_StoragebornChildhood` as a fallback, removes currently worn apparel from babies, and recalculates age-stage and natural-armor genes. The selected body gene's backstory extension can replace the fallback; the mod does not assign a Wanderer adulthood backstory.
- A Harmony postfix on `Pawn_AgeTracker.BirthdayBiological` recalculates lifecycle stages. Thresholds are baby/under 8, child from 8, adult from 18, large from 30, and gigantism from 50/70 mapping to the highest stage. Stage genes adjust carrying capacity; stages 0/1 exclude Tiny and reduce market value. Armor stages select Big-and-Small tough-skin/natural-armor genes by age slot.

## Scenario
- Adds selectable `Ice Sheet Ruins`, restricted to Ice Sheet starting tiles. Four required adult pawns are configured: three Storageborn and one Baseliner. Arrival is standing (not drop pods); the three Storageborn start in cryosleep caskets, and the Baseliner wears a Poor-quality devilstrand parka.
- A custom 16×16 marble ruin is generated on the starting map, using marble blocks for its walls and containing three Ancient Cryptosleep Caskets. The ruin is the player start area; standard natural ruin generation remains enabled.
- Starting supplies include two short bows (the only weapons), one Poor-quality devilstrand parka (equipped on the baseliner), silver, survival meals, medicine, components, steel, wood, and 500 chemfuel. Hydroponics research is completed at game start.

## Refuge quest and diagnostics
- Adds settings-gated incident `OMW_StoragebornWanderer` using standard `WandererJoin` quest behavior and normal accept/reject/timeout handling. Generated pawns receive the Storageborn xenotype, setup, and effective body selection.
- Dev action `Pawns -> Spawn Storageborn Lifecycle` spawns player-owned test pawns at ages 0, 8, 18, 30, 50, and 70.
- Ships localized settings and scenario strings, body/head/icon textures, compatibility notes, known-issue notes, and an AI-assisted development disclosure. Compatibility notes cover World Tech Level, Pick Up and Haul, 10x Carry Capacity, and other untested carry/facial-animation mods.
